::: {#models .wfrc-band .column-screen}
## Our models

::: {.wfrc-blocks}
::: {.wfrc-block}
### Travel Demand Model

Forecasts travel on the region's roads and transit. Documentation of record for every version lives on the WFRC site.

[Overview](models/tdm.qmd){.btn .btn-sm} [Documentation](https://wfrc.utah.gov/wftdm-docs/){.btn .btn-sm .btn-outline-light target="_blank"}
:::

::: {.wfrc-block .mid}
### Real-Estate Market Model

An UrbanSim-based simulation of where people and jobs may locate, used for the region's socioeconomic forecasts.

[Overview](models/remm.qmd){.btn .btn-sm} [Source](https://github.com/WFRCAnalytics/REMM-v3.0){.btn .btn-sm .btn-outline-light target="_blank"}
:::

::: {.wfrc-block .brick}
### Bike Demand Model

Estimates bicycle and micromobility demand to guide active transportation investments.

[Overview](models/bdm.qmd){.btn .btn-sm} [Source](https://github.com/WFRCAnalytics/BDM-Utah-Bike-Demand-Model){.btn .btn-sm .btn-outline-light target="_blank"}
:::
:::
:::
